summary.title: New Threat Model - Lab 1
summary.description:
Car sharing is a model of car rental where people rent cars for short periods of time, often by the
hour [4].
• Customers can have a membership in a car share or they may rent a car without a membership.
The latter is more expensive.
• Next generation car sharing will utilize self-driving cars where members can use their smart
phones to (pre)order cars and select routes and destinations.
• Self-driving cars may be scheduled centrally based on efficient selection of routes and ordered
destinations.
• Customers pay for their use of the cars based on a combination of mileage and time (duration)
of usage, and based on whether they have a membership or not.
• Routes ordered by customers are considered confidential, as well as their identity and banking
information.
• Customer credit cards get charged right after their ride ends.
• Cars have maps and driving parameters that are downloaded from a central server for offline
use (in areas where there is no reliable mobile internet).
• Cars need to be maintained regularly. They can be called in for maintenance by certified
maintenance personnel. That personnel may order test drives that are (of course) not paid
for. The maintenance personnel may also change drive parameters like the brake force applied
(if different brake pads are used), and maximum allowable acceleration and curve velocity
(based on tire condition etc.).
